prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: The **800-meter freestyle**. Before 2024, Ledecky had broken her own world record in it **four times**, second only to the **1500-meter freestyle**, where she had improved her own mark five times.
